name: Landhotel Hohenfels
beschreibung: The 4-star Landhotel Hohenfels is prominently perched in an exclusive panoramic hillside setting above Tannheim in the scenic Tannheim Valley. This boutique country hotel provides a tranquil oasis for discerning couples and epicurean travelers. Sophisticated rooms and suites blend elegant alpine woodwork with contemporary luxury and sweeping views across the valley. A major highlight is the year-round heated outdoor swimming pool overlooking the mountain peaks, complemented by an intimate sauna sanctuary. The hotel's celebrated gourmet restaurant Tannheimer Stube crafts award-winning dishes from local organic produce, all within minutes of local ski lifts and trailheads.
kurzbeschreibung: Refined 4-star boutique and gourmet hotel in Tannheim featuring a heated year-round outdoor pool and toque-awarded dining.
